refunds.note: Stripe only (Whop not included — Whop is a small share of SP revenue). The cleanest "did they regret it" signal. Healthy — see rate90DollarPct on this same object for the current figure. Note CTD carries a no-refunds policy, which sits inside this denominator.

disputes.note: Chargebacks as a share of successful charges, 90d. Well under the ~0.75% card-network danger line.

frontEndOnboarding.note: The published First Imprint workflows are the SELLING ones (Close Cart E01-E10, Close Cart SMS 01-11, Replay Emails). Every buyer-side workflow — VIP Purchase, VIP Confirmation E01-E05, Non-VIP Confirmation, Tech Call Purchase, Tech Call Booked, Replay Offer Purchase, Challenge Lifetime Access — is in DRAFT. Verified in GHL, 2026-08-23.

moneyPathTest.note: Tested, not assumed: 56 of 60 sampled (the first 60 of the deduped buyer list — a convenience sample, indicative not a measured rate): First Imprint buyers DID receive email after the challenge ended (Aug 14+). The problem is the content — the high-volume subjects (38-56 recipients) are replay urgency and the ZenithMind Elite pitch. The only welcome subjects ("Welcome to ZenithMind OS", "ZenithMind Elite Membership Approved") reached 2-3 people each — only those who ascended.

frontEndVolume.note: First-purchase units this month — the buyers arriving with no welcome sequence built to greet them. The per-offer breakdown is a top-N view, not a full decomposition, so its rows do not sum to the total.

satisfaction.note: The only satisfaction instrument SP owns: Post-Support Survey (Elite & FM) 56 responses 2026-05-04→05-19, Post-Support (CTD) 11 responses 2026-04-24→06-22. Nothing collected since 2026-06-22. Verified by paginating all 1,396 survey submissions with a widened date window (the default window hides everything older than ~30 days).

nps.note: Not found anywhere in GoHighLevel — searched and paginated to the reported total across 13 surveys, 49 forms, 462 workflows, 462 tags, 186 custom fields, 964 email templates and 495 email campaigns. What does exist is a lapsed rhythm: Force Multiplier ran daily Feedback campaigns (Days 3-10) plus "FM Feedback — Quick Question (Rich)". SP has done this before; it stopped.

onboardingEngagement.note: NOT MEASURABLE YET. Mailgun carries only the generic et_workflow tag across all 324 published workflows, so the onboarding sequence cannot be separated from every other automated email. Needs its own tag (Ben).

memberActivation.note: NOT MEASURABLE YET — no membership/activation endpoint on the GHL v2 API for this location. Not yet attempted against the ZenithPro portal or Whop, so this is "not reached" rather than "unreachable".

zmCompletion.note: Ashley's 2026-08-17 ruling makes the ZenithMind guarantee conditional on completing all four lessons AND submitting results. That makes completion the number that says whether the product landed — and it is not instrumented anywhere yet.

buyerTagging.note: GHL cannot tell you who bought. 100 contacts carry "buyer: first imprint challenge reg" against 174 Stripe registration units this month; across 90d only 71 new contacts (of every contact added in that window) carry ANY buyer tag while Stripe recorded 885 successful charges. Tested for a row cap first — the same query returns 2,472 rows on the manifesto tag, so this is missing data, not truncation.
